title: Jungle vs Ret / Arms / Disc
summary: They hold 21 answers to your 15 and both their DPS have eight each. The Priest is the only reachable target — he has no kick and no escape.

sections.title: Kill the Priest, because the other two cannot be killed
sections.body: Counts: Warrior 8, Ret 8, Priest 5. The Ret's eight include Divine Shield, two Blessings of Protection and Lay on Hands — three of them are full immunities on long cooldowns, so damage on him before minute four is spent for nothing. The Priest holds five, no mobility and no interrupt. He is the target by elimination, not by preference.

sections.title: Opener — trap first, because you cannot cast into this

steps.note: On the Priest. 25s, and it is your whole plan.
Instant. Lands the same global the trap does.
Only if both their melee are stacked on you.

sections.title: The go — every 30 seconds, off Maim

steps.note: 30s. This and Maim share a cadence; keep them aligned.
On the Hunter. 2 min — every second go at best.
180s, 8s long, 2 charges. Expect two of them.
20s. Up constantly — do not count it as a real answer.

sections.title: The clock is against you and there is no fixing it
sections.body: Their pool is deeper and both their DPS outlive any window you can build. If the Priest is not dead inside the first four goes, the game is theirs — so the correct error here is going too early, not too late. This is the one matchup where a failed go is cheaper than a held one.
